scripts.format: oxfmt package.json tsconfig.json sst.config.ts console.config.example.ts infra packages/functions/src
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json sst.config.ts console.config.example.ts infra packages/functions/src
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit --project packages/core/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit --project packages/functions/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit --project packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/web typecheck
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck
scripts.tree: mkdir -p .tmp-tree && git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD   | sed 's|/[^/]*$||'   | sort -u   | xargs -I{} mkdir -p .tmp-tree/{} && tree -d .tmp-tree && rm -rf .tmp-tree
